_comment: Read by the Reboxed app and by the site. https links only. donateUrl: donations; buyUrl: lifetime licence; betaKeyRequired: true makes the beta ask for a free beta key (Reboxed 1.17.2+), false lets everyone in without a key; betaKeyUrl: the free beta key checkout (read by 1.17.2+; the old name betaUrl made 1.17.0 ask for a key, so it stays out while the beta needs no key); price: shown in the app; betaDiscount: text shown to beta testers when the beta ends.
